literalCallbackAudit.name: 1876回合开始锁定非满条件，行动中实际回满仍减伤；满体开局中途损血不补授减伤
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('1876回合开始锁定非满条件，行动中实际回满仍减伤；满体开局中途损血不补授减伤',()=>{const low=make();low.fighters[0].hp=8000;turn(low,20132,10157,{observe(event,c){if(event==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.heal(c.a,9000,'实际回合内回复');}});assert.ok(low.fighters[0].soulState.polar1876.pending>0);assert.equal(low.fighters[0].hp,9000-damage(low,0));const high=make();turn(high,20132,10157,{observe(event,c){if(event==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.hurt(c.a,1000,'实际回合内损血','fixed');}});assert.equal(high.fighters[0].soulState.polar1876.pending,0);assert.equal(high.fighters[0].hp,8000-damage(high,0));assert.equal(high.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,1);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 1876满HP回合先制1、非满无先制且真实伤害减半，回合中回复不重采样
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('1876满HP回合先制1、非满无先制且真实伤害减半，回合中回复不重采样',()=>{const full=turn(make(),20132,10157);assert.equal(full.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,1);const low=make(),base=make({soul:false});low.fighters[0].hp=8000;base.fighters[0].hp=8000;turn(low,20132,10157);turn(base,20132,10157);assert.equal(low.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,0);const row=low.fighters[0].soulState.polar1876.reductions[0];assert.equal(row.unreducedRaw,damage(base,0));assert.equal(row.reducedRaw,damage(low,0));assert.ok(Math.abs(damage(low,0)*2-damage(base,0))<=1);assert.equal(low.fighters[0].hp,8000-damage(low,0));assert.equal(row.amount,row.unreducedRaw-row.reducedRaw);})
